list:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <TextInput source="title"/>,
 <SelectInput source="tags" choices={[
  {id: '{name: `MENU`}', name: 'MENU'},
  {id: '{name: `PUBLISHED`}', name: 'PUBLISHED'}
 ]}/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <FunctionField source="id" render={record =>
   <Transform expression={'{path: `/${id}`, id}'} id={record.id}>
    {value => <Link to={value.path}>{value.id}</Link>}
   </Transform>
  }/>
  <TextField source="title"/>
  <ArrayField source="tags">
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <ChipField source="name" size="small" />
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>
create:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <TextInput source="title"/>
   <TextInput multiline source="body" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Tags">
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" validate={[required()]} choices={[
      {id: 'MENU', name: 'MENU'},
      {id: 'PUBLISHED', name: 'PUBLISHED'}
     ]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>

<List>
 {content.map(record =>
  <Transform expression={'{path: `/${id}`, title}'} id={record.id} title={record.title}>
   {value =>
    <Link to={value.path}>
     <ListItem>
      <ListItemText primary={value.title}/>
     </ListItem>
    </Link>
   }
  </Transform>
 )}
